patterns.sourceTemplate: The first call to the emergency line was received at {time}. It came from the Hartwell landline.

patterns.sourceTemplate: Arlo Penn was found at {time} the next morning, on the east shore. Cause of death: drowning. The note does not say when he died.

patterns.sourceTemplate: One still frame, taken at {time}. It shows the dock, the post and the water. No boat and no person. It does not show what happened before or after.

patterns.sourceTemplate: From {time1} to {time2} is 2 hours 20 minutes. In that time the file has three single sources: Dess’s notebook at {time1}, Livia at {time3} and Teo at {time4}. Each one is a person’s own word. The camera shows one moment at {time2}. Nothing else covers the gap.
patterns.translationTemplate: {time1} se {time2} tak 2 ghante 20 minute hain. Is dauran file mein teen alag fard ke sources hain: {time1} par Dess ki notebook, {time3} par Livia aur {time4} par Teo. Har ek kisi shakhs ka apna bayan hai. Camera {time2} ka sirf ek lamha dikhata hai. Is khaali waqt ko aur kuch nahin bharta.

patterns.sourceTemplate: The file does not say when the group reached the shore. It only shows that a phone on the beach sent a message at {time1}, and that the first call was at {time2}. That is {duration} minutes between the two.
patterns.translationTemplate: File yeh nahin batati ke group kinare par kab pohancha. Sirf itna dikhati hai ke beach par phone ne {time1} par paighaam bheja, aur pehli call {time2} par hui. Dono ke darmiyan {duration} minute hain.

patterns.sourceTemplate: A phone on the beach sent “All safe.” at {time1}, so a call could have been made then. The first call was at {time2}, {duration} minutes later. The file does not say why they waited, or whether waiting changed anything.

patterns.sourceTemplate: In 2015, a boat called {boat} capsized off Greywater. Arlo Penn drowned. The four others on board came ashore.

patterns.sourceTemplate: Arlo Penn drowned after {boat} capsized in 2015. patterns.translationTemplate: 2015 mein {boat} ulatne ke baad Arlo Penn doob gaya. {time1} par Dess ne Mrs Penn ko do alfaaz bheje: “Sab mehfooz.” Imdadi line par pehli call {time2} par, {duration} minute baad hui. patterns.sourceTemplate: Arlo drowned. The group did not call for help until {time}, {duration} minutes after Dess sent “All safe.” to his mother. Wren ko milne wale paighaam Nell se nahin aaye. Aap nahin jaante Nell kahan hai, aur aap yeh doosre paragraph mein kehte hain taa ke is baat ko sar-sari nazar se na guzara ja sake.

patterns.sourceTemplate: It says what the file shows, in the order it happened. Arlo drowned. “All safe.” was sent at {time1}, and the first call was at {time2}. The vote last October was not unanimous. The messages to Wren did not come from you.
